description: Champion turnover catches the program off guard every time, with no plan to fill gaps or transfer knowledge.
Turnover is acknowledged as a risk, but there's no process to prepare for it.
Basic documentation exists so a new champion can pick up where the previous one left off, though onboarding is ad hoc.
The program has a defined process for onboarding new champions and transferring knowledge when someone leaves or changes roles.
The program proactively plans for turnover with succession pipelines, cross-training, and documented knowledge transfer, so departures have minimal impact on program continuity.
